text:
carmen: Quick kickoff: need a tight benchmark narrative for the launch post + 15-min webinar. Goal: one punchy hero stat, two supporting visuals, clear CTA routing. who picks up what?

nick: Ill do the hero stat and headline. Suggest: show $/1k tok + p95 tail on one slide. short footnote with N and hardware.

aya: I'll design visuals: 1) split hero (latency vs $/1k), 2) prompt-family cost breakdown. can do two-tone and social-ready square.

benchbot: Latest run (2024-10-02): hosted p95=420ms p50=130ms; dedicated p95=210ms p50=90ms; cost_norm hosted $0.030/1k, dedicated $0.019/1k; prompts: short/mid/long. CSV: /internal/bench/mini-launch/2024-10-02.csv

sam: Webinar flow: 3m problem, 6m findings (hero+chart), 4m demo, 2m CTAs. Need canonical demo numbers to avoid live flakiness.

carmen: Action plan: nick hero copy + $/1k calc (EOD today); aya figma frames (tomorrow); sam demo script with canned numbers (tomorrow AM). benchbot already uploaded appendix.

nick: Draft hero: "Dedicated delivers ~35% lower unit cost and half the tail latency in our test suite." Will replace ~% with absolute $/1k for copy.

aya: Design note: annotate slide with a tiny footnote: "N=400 requests across 3 runs; A100-80GB; runtime v2.5". keeps claims honest.

carmen: Good. Also plan landing routing: CTA A = "Try Hosted" (self-serve), CTA B = "Request Dedicated" (sales). add utm=bench_launch and a small qual textbox when B selected.

benchbot: Appendix includes run IDs and prompt lists. Demo canonical numbers: mid prompt p95 hosted=410ms, dedicated=205ms; use these in slides.

carmen: Perfect. I'll assemble the 1-pager for comms once visuals are in. :rocket:
